resources.string: Each new order while the app is closed. The bell itself rings on the alarm volume; turn it off or change its sound with the bell in the panel’s top bar.
Shown while BiteVo Admin checks for new orders in the background
When the bell stops because you’re signed out of the panel
The bell rings here when an order comes in, also with the app closed.
No connection · trying again. New orders ring once it’s back.
Stop until I open the app
New orders won’t ring until you sign in again. Tap to open the app.
Some phones stop apps in the background to save battery, so new orders wouldn’t ring with the screen off. On the next screen, allow BiteVo Admin to run in the background.
Check your internet connection and try again.
